summary.content:
Today's selection covers 102 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 64 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 45 articles published in the last 24 hours
